The live notation for high-school math is 'CCSS.Math.Content.HSA-REI.B.3', so compare `s.statementNotation?.replace(/^CCSS\.(Math|ELA-Literacy)\.(Content\.)?/, '')` against both `code` and `'HS' + code`. For grade '09', search every matching standard set, not `sets.slice(0, 3)`; the algebra set is 5th. Add gradeOf support for 'W.9-10.1a' / 'RL.9-10.4' (grade '09'). Also keep the builder's earlier request: return null for NGSS-style codes first, `if (/^(K|\d|MS|HS)-[A-Z]{2,4}\d/.test(code)) return null;`. Make `know.standard` tell 'not in the data' (200 with {standard:null}) apart from 'did not load' (network error or non-ok response), e.g. `Promise<Standard | 'missing' | null>`. lib/practice.ts `standardWording` does exactly this today; once know.standard does, StandardText can call it and standardWording can be removed.

Additive contract field so practice misses keep their diagnosis. Add `missWhy?: string` to `Attempt`: the misconception shown by a wrong try on this problem before the recorded answer, for example a distractor picked, then a right answer with help. Practice stores one attempt per problem, so today a miss followed by a right answer loses its `why`. After this lands, the practice package adds `missWhy` to AnswerRecord, records `recordAnswer(... missWhy: a.missWhy?.slice(0, 40))` in lib/practice.ts, and passes the first tagged miss from Runner (misconceptionOf on each miss, kept per slot like the other help). learning/outcomes.ts and the learner profile can then count practice distractor picks.
